GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek.

All five options are AI-generated - do not consider the possibility that a human wrote it. Read the text carefully and identify which model most likely produced it, based on writing style, structure, and phrasing.

Reply with JSON only, in exactly this form and nothing else:

{"model": "<one of GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek>", "confidence": <1-5>, "reason": "<one short sentence>"}

confidence: 1 = pure guess, 5 = certain.

--- TEXT ---
Organizations that contribute to open-source software realize meaningful operational benefits through the distribution of development responsibilities. When code is shared publicly, the ongoing costs of maintenance and updates fall across a wide network of external contributors rather than remaining the exclusive obligation of one company, freeing internal resources for other priorities while sustaining the project over longer periods.

The same public availability subjects the code to continuous examination by diverse reviewers, which elevates overall quality through collective scrutiny and allows security issues to surface and be resolved earlier than they would in a proprietary setting limited to internal teams.

Organizations also gain from the visibility of their contributions, as this activity builds a credible technical profile that draws skilled engineers seeking environments where collaborative work and open innovation are actively practiced, thereby strengthening recruitment outcomes without additional formal outreach.
--- END ---
Output the JSON object described above, and nothing else.
